# Judefly, Inc. Vendor Agreement

**Vendor:**

**Name:**

**Title:**

**Date (as of):**

This Judefly, Inc., Vendor Agreement (the "Agreement") entered into as of , or the date services under this Agreement first commenced, between Judefly, Inc. ("Company"), a corporation duly organized under the laws of the State of Delaware, ("Vendor), and located at

.

- **1. Scope.** Vendor shall supply the following goods or services to Company ("Services") including any additional attachments, which are hereby incorporated by reference, in accordance with the timeliness requirements stated herein, for good and valuable consideration, the sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, pursuant to the terms of this Agreement:
- **2. Standard of Performance.** The Vendor shall perform the Services at professional level, using its best efforts and at a minimum, to the standard of a reasonable and prudent professional in the same position in this industry. Company reserves the right to reject any and all deliverables for defective performance, within 20 days of Vendor's delivery or performance of the services identified herein.
- **3. Term of Agreement.** This Agreement shall commence on the date services were first commenced, or the date of signature herein. This Agreement shall terminate upon Company's acceptance of the specific deliverables provided by the Vendor, unless terminated earlier as stated herein, or for Vendor's breach as stated in section 19 below. Either party can terminate this Agreement at any time by submitting a written notice of intent to terminate 30 calendar days in advance of the proposed termination date. Vendor

Page 1 of 6

shall provide Company with all work product created through the date of termination before final payment shall be made.

- **4. Payment.** Vendor shall supply Company a computer-generated invoice (the "Invoice") within 24 hours of completion of all goods and services. The Invoice shall be immediately incorporated into and made a part of this Agreement. Company shall promptly pay any undisputed balances on the Invoice, and the business relationship between Vendor and Company shall terminated with respect to this Agreement.
- **5. Independent Contractor.** Vendor's relationship as to Company established by this Agreement is that of an independent contractor. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed to create any agency or employment relationship between Company or any of Company's employees and Vendor or any of Vendor's employees. Vendor shall not have any right, power, or authority to assume, create, or incur any expense, liability, or obligation, express or implied, on behalf of Company without written consent of Company.
- **6. Intellectual Property Assignment.** "Intellectual Property" shall mean any and all copyrights, trademarks, patents, trade secrets (whether or not patentable or registrable under patent, trademark, copyright, or similar laws), domain names, computer code, original works of authorship, developments, concepts, improvements, or other property, and all rights associated thereto, including all moral rights. Vendor hereby agrees that Vendor shall promptly make full written disclosure to the Company, shall hold in trust for the sole right and benefit of the Company, and hereby assign, and agree to assign, to the Company, or its designee, all of Vendor's right, title, and interest throughout the universe, in perpetuity to any and all Intellectual Property created under this Agreement or reasonably related to Vendor and Company's relationship that Vendor may solely or jointly conceive or develop or reduced to practice or fix in a tangible medium, or cause to be conceived or developed or reduced to practice or fixed in a tangible medium, during the period of this Agreement. Vendor further acknowledges that all Intellectual Property which is developed by Vendor (solely or jointly with others) within the scope of and during the period of this Agreement is a work made for hire within the meaning of 17 U.S.C. § 101. To the extent the work does not qualify as work made for hire under the Copyright Act, then Vendor hereby forever, for good and valuable consideration, assigns to the Company, all rights in and to all Intellectual Property created as a result of the work performed for the Company. Vendor hereby waives any right to the Intellectual Property and any right to challenge the ownership of the Intellectual Property in any and all courts, any and all arbitrations, and any and all contests. Vendor shall, immediately at the termination of this agree or immediately upon demand at any time by Company, supply Company with all copies, versions, drafts, or other forms of the Intellectual Property. Vendor shall retain no copies, versions, drafts, or other forms of the Intellectual Property or the ability to access copies, versions, drafts, or other forms of the Intellectual

Page 2 of 6

Property upon demand by Company or upon termination of this Agreement, whichever occurs first.

- **7. Records.** Vendor shall keep and maintain adequate and current written records of all Intellectual Property developed by Vendor (solely or jointly with others) during the term of this Agreement. The records shall be available to Company immediately upon demand by Company and remain the sole property of Company at all times.
- **8. Original Work.** All Intellectual Property created by Vendor during the Agreement shall be Vendor's own original creation and that it shall in no way infringe upon any rights of any other person or business entity or entities.
- **9. Delays.** In the event Vendor becomes aware of a situation that may delay the delivery of any services under this Agreement, or any portion of this Agreement relating to Vendor's obligations, Vendor shall provide notice in writing via email to Company inclusive of all relevant information within two (2) days of Vendor becoming aware of the potential delay.
- **10. Rights of Vendor.** Vendor understands and agrees that nothing in this Agreement is intended to grant any rights to Vendor under any patent, trademark, copyright, or other related intellectual property laws, nor shall this Agreement grant Vendor any rights in or to any proprietary information of Company, except as expressly set forth in this Agreement.
- **11. Returning Company Documents.** Vendor shall, at the time of termination of this Agreement, and no later than 72 hours after termination notice is provided, deliver to Company (and shall not keep in Vendor's possession, recreate, or deliver to anyone else) any and all Intellectual Property, devices, records, data, notes, reports, proposals, lists, correspondence, specifications, drawings, blueprints, sketches, materials, flow charts, equipment, other documents or property, or reproductions of any aforementioned items developed by Vendor pursuant to this Agreement or otherwise belonging to the Company, its successors or assigns.
- **12. Indemnification.** Vendor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Company from and against any and all losses, costs, or damages of any kind (including, but not limited to, attorneys' fees and court costs) to the extent arising out of Vendor's breach of this Agreement, including breach of the confidentiality provisions herein, Vendor's negligence or willful misconduct, or Vendor's violation of a third party's intellectual property right.

Page 3 of 6

## General Provisions.

- **13. Governing Law.** The validity, interpretation, construction, and performance of this Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Arizona, without giving effect to the principles of conflict of laws.
- **14. Entire Agreement.** This Agreement and related Invoices set forth the entire agreement and understanding between the Company and Vendor relating to the subject matter herein and supersedes all prior discussions between Company and Vendor. No modification or amendment to this Agreement shall be effective unless in writing signed by the parties hereto. No waiver of a provision by Company shall inhibit Company's ability to later reasonably enforce said provision. Any subsequent change or changes to Vendor's duties, obligations, rights, or compensation shall not affect the validity or scope of this Agreement.
- **15. Severability.** If any provision of this Agreement or part thereof shall be held by a court or other tribunal of competent jurisdiction to be unenforceable, then such provision or part thereof shall be excised herefrom and the remaining provisions of this Agreements and parts thereof shall remain in full force and effect.
- **16. Headings.** The headings in this Agreement are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
- **17. Successors and Assigns.** This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of Company's heirs, executors, administrators, legal representatives, successors, and assigns.
- **18. Survival.** The provisions of this Agreement shall survive the termination of this Agreement.
- **19. Breach.** If Vendor breaches any provision of this Agreement and if such breach is not cured within five (5) days after said breach, Company shall have the right to terminate this Agreement by giving written notice thereof to the Vendor. Company may immediately terminate the Agreement by written notice if the Vendor materially breaches the Agreement. Any Invoices provided by Vendor shall be prorated to reflect the proportion of the work Vendor completed versus the total work Vendor agreed to perform. Determination of this proportion is within the sole, reasonable discretion of Company.
- **20. Counterparts.** This Agreement may be executed in any number of separate counterparts, all of which, when taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument.

Page 4 of 6

- **21. Assignment.** Vendor shall not assign any or all of its obligations under this Agreement to any other party without the written consent of Company.
- **22. Confidentiality.** The terms and conditions of this Agreement are absolutely confidential between the parties, and Vendor shall not disclose the terms and conditions to anyone else, except as shall be necessary to effectuate the Agreement's terms. Vendor shall not disclose any information relating to Company, its Intellectual Property, its employees, its business practices, its successors and assigns or affiliated entity or individual, or any other non-public information belonging to or licensed by the Company (collectively, "Confidential Information"), regardless of the nature of the information or if the information is or later becomes public. Any violation of this section shall be deemed a material breach of this Agreement. Vendor may also receive or have access to customer's or its licensor's personally identifiable information ("PII"). Vendor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to protect all user information collected by Company, and where applicable, by Vendor, including all PII, from unauthorized access or use, and Vendor shall promptly report in writing any unauthorized access or use of such PII to the Company.
- **23. Name Prohibition.** Vendor may not disclose Company's name, its successors and assigns, affiliated entities, or any identifying information for any reason to any third party unless necessary to effectuate the terms of this Agreement.
- **24. Choice of Law.** This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Arizona.
- **25. Venue.** The parties agree that all actions and proceedings arising out of or relating directly or indirectly to this Agreement or any ancillary agreement or any other related obligations shall be litigated solely and exclusively in the state or federal courts located in the City of Phoenix, Arizona, and that such courts are convenient forums. Each party hereby submits to the personal jurisdiction of such courts for purposes of any such actions or proceedings.
- **26. ADVICE OF COUNSEL.** VENDOR ACKNOWLEDGES THAT, IN EXECUTING THIS AGREEMENT, VENDOR HAD THE OPPORTUNITY TO SEEK THE ADVICE OF LEGAL COUNSEL, AND VENDOR HAS READ AND UNDERSTANDS ALL OF THE TERMS AND PROVISIONS OF THIS AGREEMENT. THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AGAINST COMPANY BY REASON OF THE DRAFTING OR PREPARATION HEREOF.
- **27. Notice.** All notice requirements under this Assignment shall be delivered in a signed writing, and are considered complete upon delivery via certified mail or via email, to the other Party's address below, unless delivery is incomplete or fails to reach the receiving party.
